_decision: 2026-08-14: which pages may carry adult affordances - the account nav link, the create-account link, the mailing nav link and the footer mailing CTA - is declared here and nowhere else. Before this record the question had no answer in the tree: assets/mbm-platform.js allowed them on every page and suppressed them only where a page said data-mbm-adult-features="off", and exactly one page in the estate said it. A page that forgot the marker got the affordances, silently, and nothing failed.
_failClosed: The default is now the opposite. adultFeaturesAllowed() returns true only for data-mbm-adult-features="on". Absent, misspelt, mangled by a renderer or simply forgotten all mean the same thing: no adult affordances. The failure mode of a mistake is a missing link on an adult page, which is visible and gets reported, instead of a sign-in link on a child's page, which is not.
_notANewConvention: This reuses the attribute the estate already had, with its default inverted. No new data-mbm-* marker is introduced. Pages that are deliberately not adult keep saying "off" where they already said it - "off" and absent are the same verdict now, but the explicit form still records intent, and /for/pupils/ in particular is asserted to carry it by verify_games_audience_faces.py and by the browser suite.
_whyNotTheKofiSetAlone: The ruled Ko-fi adult set is a COMMERCE ruling - which surfaces may ask for money. Reusing it verbatim as the adult-affordance allow-list would have removed the account navigation from /account/, /members/, /mailing-list/ and /privacy/: the pages whose entire function is the account and mailing machinery, and the page that carries the data-rights routes. Those four are listed here with that reason against each. The Ko-fi ten are all present, because a surface that may ask for money is by definition adult; verify_games_audience_faces.py asserts that containment rather than trusting these two lists to agree.
_measuredExclusions: Three pages that carry adult affordances today are deliberately NOT here, each on evidence. / (the chooser) is mixed-audience, and data/audience-homepages.json already records Matt's ruling that it carries 'no /account/ or /members/ route at all'. That ruling is currently violated at RUNTIME: the chooser's source has zero /account/ hrefs and passes its static gate, while the browser shows one anchor carrying data-mbm-account-nav, injected by accountTargets(). Leaving the chooser off this list is what makes the ruling true in the browser as well as in the source. /resources/ is pupil-reachable through the pupil homepage's no-JS search fallback and was closed to commerce on 2026-08-13 for that reason; the same reasoning excludes it here. /stats/ is device-local activity with no account function.
_boundary: This record governs the four platform-injected affordances only. It does not remove links a page carries in its own markup: /games/ and /stats/ both hold a static Members link that no default can reach, and /privacy/ holds a static Account link. Those are page content, and changing them is a copy decision, not a default.
